name: the ISRC cell is never rebuilt into a list
why: Without the rebuild the cell keeps ISRC Scout's sibling anchors: no <li>, so no multi-row cell and no collapse toggle, and no <code>, so no CC-XXX-YY-NNNNN display or segment spans.

name: the ISRC column name gate only knows "ISRCs"
why: The 📊 ISRC sections are gated by column name; with the old literal the ISRC column gets none of them.

name: the ISRC column name gate only knows "ISRCs" (finding)
why: The same gate decides which columns the 'Invalid ISRC format' finding tests; the ISRC cell would never be flagged.

name: ISRC is not a collapsable column
why: The list alone is not enough: initCollapsableColumns() only builds toggles for declared columns, so the 2- and 3-ISRC cells get no ▶ and the header no collapse button.

name: the rebuilt cells lose ISRC Scout's ii-col class
why: ISRC Scout's observer adds fresh cells to every row with no ':scope > .ii-col' child. A rebuild that renamed the cells would get a second, bare ISRC and Links cell in every row on the next DOM change.
grep: no extra cells from ISRC Scout

name: the Links icons get no platform names
why: Without the names the cell's only text is the 'N links' badge (stripped), so the column has no values at all: no count, no Platform section.

name: the 'N links' badge stays in the filter text
why: The digits join the platform names ('Deezer Spotify 2 Tidal'), so a badge digit becomes part of a value and the count no longer means 'distinct platform sets'.

name: a ticked platform matches no row
why: The entry is listed with the right count, but ticking it filters every row out.

name: a ticked platform is not highlighted
why: The rows narrow correctly but nothing marks which icon matched: the hidden name gets no highlight span, so the outline rule has nothing to see.

name: the outline rule never matches
why: The highlight lands in a display:none span; only the :has() rule makes it visible as an outline on the icon.

name: the outline rule never matches (typed column filter)
why: A typed filter reaches the hidden names through the generic highlighter; the outline is still the only thing that shows it.

name: platform entries lose their icon
why: The entries still filter; only the trailing icon is gone.

name: Links icons keep SUPER MIND CONTROL's new-tab padding
why: Without the reset every icon is 16px wider and carries the red new-window sprite; six platforms with link counts wrap onto two lines (debug/links-overflow.html).

name: the Links platform ignores data-ii-platform
why: ISRC Scout >= 9e4cdd59 (#938) names the platform in data-ii-platform; its tip wording is presentation. Read only the tip and a reworded tip loses every platform.

name: the Links platform ignores data-tip
why: ISRC Scout 2026.11.06 to 9e4cdd59 has the platform only in data-tip, no title: the platform section comes up empty (the measured bug).

name: ISRC Scout's data-tip stays on our icons
why: ISRC Scout's shared #mbu-tip handler reacts to any [data-tip] in the document and stacks its tip beside our card.
grep: markup "data-tip" each icon has our own card

name: the Links icons get no card of ours
why: Without _setTip() the icons carry no data-mb-tip and no hover text naming the platform and its URLs.
grep: markup "meta" each icon has our own card

name: multi-table renders are not marked data-mbu-foreign
why: Without the mark an ISRC Scout >= 9e4cdd59 treats our tables as its own again: its wipe-and-refill replaces our decorated ISRC/Links cells with bare ones.

name: multi-table renders are not marked data-mbu-foreign (the mark itself)
why: Same planted defect, seen by the assertion on the attribute.
